buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Accounts Officer Cash o/o CCA HP Shimla payable at SHIMLA . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. (a). The Service Provider shall have its Headquarters or Registered Office located within the State of Himachal Pradesh. Documentary evidence in support of this requirement must be submitted along with the bid. Non compliance shall render the bid liable for rejection. (b) The Buyer reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity of manpower to be supplied b y up to Fifty percent (50%) of the bid quantity at the time of contract placement. Furthermore, the B uyer may, during the currency of the contract, increase the quantity by up to Fifty percent (50%) of the contracted quantity at the same rates, terms, and conditions. The Service Provider shall be bou nd to accept such variations. (c). The Buyer reserves the right to extend the duration of the contract by a further period of one (1 ) year, under the same terms, conditions, and rates as specified in the original contract. The Service Provider shall comply with such extension without any revision in commercial or contractual terms. (d). The Buyer reserves the right to discontinue the services at any time due to administrative exige ncies by providing thirty (30) days’ prior written notice. No claims for compensation, damages, or lo sses shall be entertained on account of such termination.. (e) EPF & ESI cards to be submitted as soon as staff is deployed before submitting the first bill. (f) To be eligible for award of contract, Bidder/OEM must possess following Certificates/Test Reports on the date of bid opening (to be uploaded with bid): EPF registration, ESI registration, Labour regist ration & GST registration certificates.

(ii). PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: 1. Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location fir st i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, E SIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. (iii). Past experience: Service Provider is required to have served Ministries/Departments under Cent ral/State Government during last 1 year. (iv). Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria Certificate regarding having satisfactorily supplied similar servic es to Central/State Govt. offices/PSUs duly showing the amount of contract should be uploaded with the Bid. GeM contract order shall not qualify as an experience certificate. (v). Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. (vi) Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or simil ar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. .
